Bhind Authorities Seize Suspected Fake DAP Fertilizer, File FIRs

Authorities in Bhind, Madhya Pradesh, have taken action against an alleged illegal trade and counterfeit DAP fertilizer. Following raids in Phup and Bharoli, an operation in Jamhora resulted in the seizure of 40 sacks of suspected fake DAP fertilizer. In a separate but related action, 7 people were booked in an FIR as 600 sacks were being unloaded from a truck. The seized fertilizer is undergoing testing.
